summary.summary: London is the default Open Citylog atlas city. The generated public artifacts include partial row-level events from brownfield, London Fire Brigade, TfL disruption, and curated milestone sources, plus broader catalog-level source markers for remaining families.

matrix.label: Greater London Authority London Datastore
matrix.notes: Use dataset-level licence and update metadata. Do not assume all portal records share one licence.

matrix.label: Global Landsat and Sentinel-2 archives
matrix.notes: Public-domain Landsat back to the 1970s and Copernicus Sentinel-2 from 2015 fill gaps where London lacks an open citywide ortho time series.

matrix.label: Historic England aerial archive and Environment Agency vertical aerials
matrix.notes: Historic England exposes 540,000+ digitized photos; Environment Agency vertical aerials provide official airborne mapping; OS MasterMap Imagery is licensed.

matrix.label: Planning London Datahub and APIs
matrix.notes: PLD core platform plus the public guest API; preserve borough/source references and API connection schema version.

matrix.label: London Development Database archive and PlanApps comments
matrix.notes: LDD archive plus PlanApps comments back to 2012; minimize personal-text display from public consultation records.

matrix.label: Residential approvals, starts, and completions dashboards
matrix.notes: Three GLA dashboards derived from PLD; preserve borough submission caveats.

matrix.label: OS 3D Mesh and London Building Stock Model v2
matrix.notes: Beta and analytical-model access only; not equivalent to NYC's open lot-level open parcel/building stack.

matrix.label: OS Open Roads, USRN, UPRN, OpenMap Local, Open Zoomstack
matrix.notes: OS OpenData products are current open national layers; pair with snapshots for historical change detection.

matrix.label: DfT road traffic statistics for London
matrix.notes: Preserve the Counted versus Estimated method flag and upweight directly counted observations.

matrix.label: Transport for London open data and cycle hire
matrix.notes: TfL Unified API plus accessibility (PTAL), demand, BikePoint occupancy, and Santander Cycle hires from 30 July 2010.

matrix.label: Nomis, BRES, ONS, and GLA borough-by-sector jobs
matrix.notes: Strong long-run labour and demography stack; treat 2025-2026 as not yet published unless verified.

matrix.label: HM Land Registry Price Paid, UK HPI, and VOA private rents
matrix.notes: Best official stack for property transactions and rent/price trend context; verify Price Paid permitted-use guidance.

matrix.label: Talk London, Annual London Survey, and consultations
matrix.notes: No citywide 311-style ledger; treat as opinion and consultation evidence rather than service-request exhaust.

matrix.label: OpenStreetMap and ohsome history
matrix.notes: Use as mapped-change evidence with explicit OSM caveats.
